root_cause.text: `pcpu_init_value` used `copy_map_value_long` which copies `round_up(map->value_size, 8)` bytes, but for some map types (e.g., BPF_MAP_TYPE_CGROUP_STORAGE) the source value may have a smaller actual size (not rounded to 8 bytes), causing an out-of-bounds read when copying to per-CPU map elements.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `copy_map_value_long` to `copy_map_value` in `pcpu_init_value`, and the CVE description explicitly states that “pcpu_init_value assumes that all sources are rounded up to 8 bytes” and that the source (e.g., CGROUP_STORAGE) may not be, leading to OOB when the copy size is rounded up.
